create_resampling_dataset: create a ResamplingDataset that randomly samples from a base dataset each epoch with configurable weights
build_weighted_resampling_dataset: build a ResamplingDataset with probability weights to bias sampling toward specific dataset items
test_set_epoch: test the ResamplingDataset set_epoch method to regenerate sampled indices for a new epoch
review_ordered_indices: review the ResamplingDataset ordered_indices method that returns indices sorted by sequence length
summarize_prefetch: summarize the ResamplingDataset prefetch method that preloads dataset items by mapped indices
